[Verse 1]
[Ebm]To the sound of a
heartbeat pounding away
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Ebm]To the rhythm of the
awful rusted machin-
[Eb5]es [B5][Gb5][Ab5]
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Absus2]We toss and
turn but don't sleep [Gbsus2]
[Absus2]Each breath we
take makes us thieves [Gbsus2]
[B]Like causes
without rebels
[Db]Just talk but pro-
mise nothing else

[Chorus]
[Ebm]We crawl
[Gb]on our knees for you
[Db]Under a
[Abm]sky no longer blue
[Ebm]We sweat
[Db]all day long for you
[Abm]
[B]
[Ebm]But we sow
[Gb]seeds to see us through
[Db]'Cause sometimes
[Abm]dreams just don't come true
[Ebm]We wait to
[Db]reap what we are due
[Abm]
[B]

[Bridge]
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]

[Ebm]To the rhythm of a
time bomb ticking away
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Eb5]And [B5]the blare [Gb5]of [Ab5]the
[Eb5]sirens [Gb5][B5]combing the [Ab5]streets
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Eb5]  [B5]  [Gb5]  [Ab5]
[Absus2]Chased down like
dogs we run from [Gbsus2]
[Absus2]Your grasp until
the sun comes up

[Chorus]
[Ebm]We crawl
[Gb]on our knees for you
[Db]Under a
[Abm]sky no longer blue
[Ebm]We sweat
[Db]all day long for you
[Abm]
[B]

[Gb]seeds to see us through
[Db]'Cause sometimes
[Abm]dreams just don't come true
[Ebm]Look now at
[Db]what they've done to

[Bridge]
[Abm]you
[B]
[Bb]White needles bur-
ied in the red
[Db]The engine roars
and then it gives
[B]But never [Db]dies
'Cause we don't
[Ebm]live We just [Bb]survive
On the
[B]scraps that you
[Db]throw away

[Interlude]

[Bridge]
[Ebm]I won't crawl
[Gb]on my knees for you
[Db]I won't believe the lies
[Abm]that hide the truth
[Ebm]I won't sweat
[Db]one more drop for you
[Abm]
[B]
[Ebm]'Cause we are the
[Gb]rust upon your gears
[Db]We are the in-
[Abm]sect in your ears
[Ebm]We crawl
[Db]We crawl
[Abm]We crawl...
[B]all over you

[Chorus]
[Ebm]We sow the
[Gb]seeds to see us through
[Db]Our days are
[Abm]precious and so few
[Ebm]We all
[Db]reap what we are due
[Abm]
[B]
[Ebm]Under this
[Gb]sky no longer blue
[Db]We bring the dawn
[Abm]long overdue
[Ebm]We crawl
[Db]We crawl
[Abm]We crawl...
[B]all over you
[Ebm]
